faults.title: Water-pump leak
faults.description: Some third-generation A3 owners have reported water-pump leaks. Check for coolant loss or fluid beneath the car and have the cooling system inspected before overheating develops.

faults.title: Retracting infotainment screen creak
faults.description: The A3's pop-up infotainment display can creak as it rises or retracts. Check the mechanism in both directions; lubrication or replacement may be needed if the noise persists.
